note: The decoded gate row this recipe reached when it shipped; tools/qa-cover-recipes.mjs renders it again and fails when median d or the moving share move more than 15 %, seamLocal leaves the cover TARGET, the file passes 2 MiB or the render exits non-zero. Measured 2026-10-20 on headless Chrome's software rung with CPU raster and libwebp 1.6.0.
base: test/fixtures/cover/painted-light-five-panel.png in this repository (1536x1024, the five-panel family painting), the painting the PAINTING block was measured on; another painting needs its own block

treatment.request: Make the LitFamily README motion cover from the painted robot line-up.
treatment.idea: A window of work light walks the sleeping bays while the lead robot breathes and a comet laps its frame.
treatment.recipeReason: The painting already carries the brand, so the loop relights it instead of drawing over it.
treatment.beat: A light edge sweeps across the painting once per loop.

layers.slow: A comet laps the lead frame and motes rise one screen per loop.
layers.mid: A sharp-edged light window walks the bays once per loop, with scan bands at two passes.
layers.beat: Eyes breathe twice, one blink, and the LIT. flare pulses at t = 0 and 0.5.

system.rule: One light window and one scan band rule.
system.offset: Each bay's phase comes from its x position.

treatment.ambition: Light reads as moving edges that survive the encoder, and the seam disappears under the flare.

feather-150.defect: A 150 px soft light edge: the window reads as a soft wash instead of a moving edge. At this recipe's encode (q83, edge q97 for 18 frames) the encoder keeps the soft edge, so no motion gate sees it; it measured 2.59 MB against 2.06 MB with median d and the seam inside TARGET. What it reliably trips is the 2 MiB size TARGET. The wash itself is caught by look review on the sheet, not by a gate.
